serverUrl.title: MoorAI console URL
serverUrl.description: Where content-free signals are posted (POST <serverUrl>/api/alerts). Leave unset for local-only use.

installToken.title: Install token
installToken.description: Sent as X-Install-Token and used as the key for the one-way content hash, the same token the MoorAI agent uses.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: coach warns and lets the user proceed; block prevents a high-severity send.

reportEnabled.title: Send signals
reportEnabled.description: Master switch for reporting to the console.

lockSettings.title: Lock settings
lockSettings.description: When true, the options page shows the managed values read-only.
